evidence.claim: The territorial legislature renamed it to avoid confusion with Bannack in what is now Montana.
evidence.quote: the new Idaho Territorial legislature changed the town's name to “Idaho City,” to avoid confusion with Bannack, in present-day Beaverhead County, the southwestern corner of Montana.

evidence.claim: Its boom brought more than 200 businesses, including three dozen saloons and two dozen law offices, by the mid-1860s.

evidence.claim: Wood supplied shelter and heat, but also fed four town fires between 1865 and 1871.
